title: Closing thanks
summary: Allen thanks the Bruniess and ends the interview.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Well, I want to thank you for the wonderful visit we've had here. I wish I could tell you more about it. No, that's very good. I think back more. That's very good. I think we have most of that life now down here that we remember about it. And I appreciated hearing about your father too.
And the old times. I'll turn it off. Good stuff. Thank you.
